title: vortaforge/core archive registry (v2)
description: Registry of every frozen project in archived/. schema_version 2 adds the hard-disable fields (disarmed, is_datapack, quality_score, pack_format, description, last_commit, original_path). Consumers MUST treat an entry as disabled unless disarmed is false, and they MUST treat a missing disarmed field as true so that a v1 registry cannot accidentally re-enable archived code.

updated_on.description: Date the registry was last edited.

summary.description: One-paragraph human summary of what this registry means.

id.description: Stable identifier. Also the name of archived/patches/<id>/ when the entry has patches.

reason.description: Why the project was retired. Required. A retirement always has a reason.

minecraft.description: Minecraft version range the project last targeted, free text.

path.description: Path inside this repo, null if the code is not kept here. MUST start with archived/ when set.

original_path.description: Where the project lived before it was archived, e.g. packs/guikitfw.

disarmed.description: true = hard-disabled: the build, CI and packaging must ignore this project. Absent is treated as true.

is_datapack.description: true for anything that is, generates, lints, tests or serves datapacks. Every such entry must be disarmed.

quality_score.description: Review score, when recorded. Low scores are a documented reason for retirement.

pack_format.description: pack.mcmeta pack_format / min_format / max_format at archival time, as text.

description.description: What the project did, in one line.

last_commit.description: Last commit date and author recorded at archival time.
